scope: Actual isolated production main lifecycle acceptance; not capacity or deployment acceptance

initialization.command: actual main migrate up --migrationsDir=<all repository migrations> --dev=false; then actual main serve --dev=false

raw_serve_initial_attempts.cause: PocketBase Bootstrap runs system migrations before JS account bootstrap; app migrations are applied afterward by Serve. Empty data directory therefore requires the existing migrate-before-serve initialization.

tests.note: Before the additional explicit failure_code=PROCESS_RESTARTED assertion; the final race run includes it.

private_hook_instrumentation.barrier_position: Immediately after successful runInTransaction return; independently confirmed committed payload through a mode=ro SQLite connection.

gates.visible_state_byte_equality: pass: canonical full-row JSON of current/history/events/pages/published markers unchanged across stage, rejection, restart and cleanup

limitations: Functional test on Darwin; not a production deployment, isolated 4-core capacity acceptance, or an RSS/latency benchmark.

This crash stops at the first committed findings chunk; events, derivations and retirements counts at crash are zero. Other stage/byte-budget cases remain covered by the dedicated publication tests, not claimed by this process fixture.
The test binary invokes the actual production main in subprocesses with all repository hooks/migrations, plus the documented private hook barrier/sentinel. It does not test a built container image.
One full-directory migrate up does not replace existing Docker numeric per-file migration-order acceptance.
Cleanup gate proves removal of this one bounded committed chunk; it does not measure multi-minute backlog drain.
